summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of SIPRO Phase 49 (Penutupan Buku, Laporan Owner, Pajak & Kepatuhan) - All 15 user stories PASSED including the 3 priority items from previous iteration (US11, US13, US14)

US14 (PRIORITY): RBAC sales@sipro.co.id at /tax - Access denied card (tax-access-denied) shows human-readable title 'Perpajakan & Kepatuhan hanya untuk tim Keuangan', 'Kembali ke Beranda' button present, NO technical permission text, NO tax tabs visible, NO React errors

US11 (PRIORITY): e-Bupot cancel button - 1 e-Bupot row found, PDF button present, Correct button opens dialog (p49-bupot-action-dialog), validation works (<10 chars disables submit, >=10 enables), cancel button (p49-bupot-action-cancel) works without overlay issues

US1: Closing checklist (finlead@sipro.co.id) - 9 closing items (p49-closing-item) with human-readable labels, 5 'Buka sumbernya' links (p49-closing-item-link), status pills showing state, metrics cards showing revenue/expense/profit
US2: Close period with holds (finlead@sipro.co.id) - Close Period button (p49-closing-close-btn) visible and accessible

US4: Year closing panel (finlead@sipro.co.id) - Year panel (p49-year-panel) present, 1 year row (p49-year-row), 1 check item (p49-year-check-item), year close button (p49-year-close-btn) opens dialog (p49-year-dialog), cancel button (p49-year-cancel) works
US5: RBAC finance role (finance@sipro.co.id) - Override button (p49-closing-override-btn) correctly NOT visible for finance role (only finlead can override)

US6: Cash flow by project (owner@sipro.co.id) - Tie-out badge (p49-cfproject-tieout) shows 'Tie-out cocok' with amounts (Σ proyek Rp 5.669.144.936 = konsolidasi), 1 project row (p49-cfproject-row), unassigned row (p49-cfproject-unassigned) present
